data.one_liner: A comprehensive observability and monitoring platform for iOS and Android apps.
data.what_it_does: Captures telemetry data, crashes, performance metrics, and logs, then sends them to Embrace. It supports automatic time-to-first-frame span instrumentation, HTTP tracing, and OpenTelemetry API compliance.
use_when: You need detailed monitoring, performance tracing, and crash reporting for iOS and Android apps.
You want to track app startup times and navigation performance.
avoid_when: You do not need native mobile observability or crash reporting features.
You prefer a different error tracking service like Sentry.
strengths: Automatic span instrumentation for startup and navigation.
Integrates natively with iOS and Android.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on iOS and Android.
Tied to the Embrace backend ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Please see the Embrace docs for integration instructions on iOS and Android.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Sentry for error tracking, crash reporting, and performance monitoring instead of Embrace.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the official Flutter-specific wrapper for Sentry error tracking and performance monitoring.

data.minimal_example: A package that captures telemetry and sends it to Embrace. [Please see the Embrace docs for integration instructions.](https://embrace.io/docs/flutter/integration/)
